title: Custom Layout Creator
description: Design and save a custom Editor layout that puts Scene and Game side‑by‑side, with Console at the bottom.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Build a personalized Unity layout.

1. Open your HelloUnity project.
2. Using the default layout as a starting point, drag the **Game** tab so it sits beside the **Scene** view (split horizontally or vertically).
3. Move the **Console** window to dock it at the bottom, next to the **Project** window.
4. Resize the panels until you are comfortable with the workspace.
5. Save the layout using **Layout → Save Layout**. Name it "Progly Custom".
6. Take a screenshot showing the arrangement. Include the Layout dropdown open to prove you saved it.
hints: To dock a tab, drag it by its title bar; blue highlights indicate potential docking zones.
If you accidentally close a window, reopen it from **Window → General**.
expectedOutput: A screenshot of the Editor with your custom layout visible and the Layout dropdown showing "Progly Custom".
solutionCode: No code required. This is a hands-on interface task.
